MOVE: Move continuously along a local cue or scan; collision checked.
CAPTURE: Acquire one accessible cognate native antigen packet.
RETAIN: Retain a local immune complex on an FDC.
PROCESS: Start timed antigen processing, then peptide loading.
PRIME: Maintain a cognate DC contact with costimulation to prime CD4.
HELPER: Start the activated CD4 border-helper program.
HELP: Maintain a local, linked B–helper contact; finite license.
ENTER_GC: Start a timed founder program near follicular support.
DIVIDE: Spend one division license and complete a timed cell cycle.
RECYCLE: Use renewed help to return to the proliferative program.
MEMORY: Commit to memory; no constitutive antibody secretion.
MATURE: Mature a plasmablast into a noncycling plasma cell.
SECRETE: Secrete antibody of the existing clone and isotype.
CLEAR: Engulf one adjacent apoptotic cell into a finite debris queue.
MAINTAIN: Maintain local stromal support for follicular programs.

inputs.placement: Proposed local antigen challenge: two finite native-antigen packets beside the selected DC and B cell.

episode.assumptions: Uncalibrated representative monolayer; all numbers proposed. Fixtures are not Jev responses. Deliberately selected neighboring cognate trio and local antigen input; programmed plasmablast-favoring choices. Not an unbiased outcome estimate.

presentation.note: Playback time is compressed. Cell poses, arrival trails, presentation symbols and antibody icons are illustrative; transitions, contact eligibility, clocks and secretion counts come from the LN kernel.

beats.title: Vaccine antigen arrives
beats.description: A local vaccine-antigen pulse perturbs the quiet tissue. Two finite packets of the same protein reach a dendritic cell and a cognate B cell.

beats.title: The cells capture antigen
beats.description: The dendritic cell takes antigen inside. The B cell independently captures native antigen through its matching BCR.

beats.title: Protein becomes a presented peptide
beats.description: Internalized protein is processed, then loaded onto MHC II. Mint surface markers show the peptide–MHC complexes on the DC and B cell.

beats.title: The dendritic cell primes CD4
beats.description: A nearby CD4 T cell recognizes the DC’s compatible peptide–MHC II with costimulation. Their physical contact starts a timed priming program.

beats.title: CD4 enters the follicular-helper pathway
beats.description: The activated CD4 cell becomes a Tfh precursor. Cognate B-cell interaction completes the helper state in this proposed model.

beats.title: The helper licenses this B cell
beats.description: The B cell presents the matching peptide to the CD4 helper. Local CD40-dependent help grants a finite differentiation license.

beats.title: The B cell chooses the plasmablast route
beats.description: The scripted policy selects the eligible plasmablast program. The same B-cell identity and clone are preserved while differentiation takes time.

beats.title: The plasmablast releases antibody
beats.description: The committed plasmablast secretes IgM of its original clone and antigen specificity. Each recorded secretion adds one arbitrary output unit.
